senses.gloss: prefix (b. h.) in, within, on &c. בו ביום on that day; באותו מקום in that very place; מיניה וביה from it and in it, i.e. out of the very thing.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 101b:13">B. Mets. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>אגרא … מיניה וביה</he> she hired carriers, paying them from the very wine which the man had placed in her storeroom.—<cite ref="B00280"><he>בּוֹן</he></cite> = <he>בְּהוֹן</he>. Y. Ber. II, 4ᶜ bot.; a. fr.
